subject: Follow-up: Multilingual model evals & next steps (EU + APAC locales)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jun Park <jun.park@hanaco.jp>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Multilingual model evals & next steps (EU + APAC locales)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet you and the Hanaco team. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what we heard:

- Goals: improve search relevance and product copy localization across JP/KO/EN (APAC) and FR/DE/ES (EU).
- Main constraints: 99th percentile latency target < 350ms for generation endpoints; data residency requirement for some EU stores.
- Success metrics: relevance NDCG uplift +5-8% on JP/KO queries; localization BLEU/chrF thresholds TBD.

Next steps (proposed):
1) We'll run a focused eval across a 5k prompt set you shared for JP/KO and a 3k set for FR/DE/ES.
2) Redwood will recommend 2 model variants (low-cost and high-quality) and provide prompt sets + benchmark links by EOD tomorrow.
3) Share a cost/latency estimate for hosted vs Dedicated (if you need isolation) — see attached estimate.

Attached: redwood_multilingual_eval_promptset_v1.csv (sample prompt set), token_cost_estimate.xlsx

I've looped in Priyom (SE) to confirm evaluation config and quantization / latency tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- The prompt set attached is a representative extract; we can provide a full 15k corpus if helpful.
- For EU stores, we need data residency for logs and cache. Can Redwood route EU traffic to an EU region with private logs?
- Regarding quality, our localization team is most sensitive about idiomatic Japanese and German product descriptions.

If you can share the two recommended model variants and a quick matrix (latency / token cost / expected quality), we can prioritize which stores to pilot.

Best,
Jun
Head of ML Platforms
Hanaco Retail
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Jun Park <jun.park@hanaco.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Multilingual model evals & next steps (EU + APAC locales)

Hi Jun — following up with the technical plan. Quick summary of recommended models and eval setup below.

Recommended variants:
- Variant A (cost-optimized): redwood-v2-7b-q4f16 (quantized) — expected tradeoffs: ~15-20% lower token cost, slight drop on idiomatic constructs for JP/DE vs larger models.
- Variant B (quality-optimized): redwood-v2-13b or redwood-instruct-13b (float) — higher cost, better handling of idiomatic translation/paraphrase.

Eval plan:
- Run the provided 5k JP/KO set + 3k FR/DE/ES on both variants; measure BLEU/chrF and relevance NDCG for search workloads.
- Include targeted prompt perturbations (formal->casual, numeric units, product attributes) to test regression risks.
- For EU logistic constraint: route EU requests to our eu-central region with logs stored in a customer-configured S3 bucket (we can enable KMS/HSM for key control). This will be included in the Dedicated/private offering if full isolation is required.

Links:
- Benchmark dashboard: https://redwood-inference.internal/benchmarks/multilingual-2027#hanaco
- Eval runbook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3CdocLink

I attached a PDF with model recommendation notes and the prompt set sample. I'll start the first runs once we confirm the full prompt corpus.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
